register.description: The debug counter control to select how the associated counter is incremented and starts and stops. Writing to this register will reset the counter.

bitfield.description: Selects what type of counter the Debug Counter is used. 0 Increment counter the start selected event increment the counter on each rising edge.1 One shot cycle count the first time the rising edge start count is generated and stops when the stop event rising edge is seen. If additional start events are seen the counter will not change. The counter will not roll over.2 Continous cycle count the counter counts cycles when start event rising edge is seen and stops when stop rising edge is seen and starts again when the start event rising edge is seen. The counter will not roll over.

The event type to use for the timer. The event will be the event from the given flow in the stop flow field. 0 A scheduling request is sent to a scheduling unit for the flow1 A read command is sent for the flow2 A write command is sent for the flow3 A read data response is received for the flow4 A write data response is received for the flow5 The read data response for the last request of the TR/PKT has been received6 The write data response for the last request of the TR/PKT has been received8
The flow number that generates the event to start or increment the counter Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

The event type to use for the timer. The event will be the event from the given flow in the start flow field. 0 A scheduling request is sent to a scheduling unit for the flow1 A read command is sent for the flow2 A write command is sent for the flow3 A read data response is received for the flow4 A write data response is received for the flow5 The data read response for the last request of the TR/PKT has been received6 The data write response for the last request of the TR/PKT has been received8
The flow number that generates the event to start or increment the counter Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The debug event control to select when the debug controller can issue an event that can be used by another debug event control. Writing to this register will reset the counter.

bitfield.description: Selects when or if an event will be generated by the counter. 0 No event is generated.1 Exact match.2 The counter is bit-wise ANDed with the cnt match and the event is when this mask is non-zero.
The value that if set the counter generates an event. It can also be used as a mask based on event type Reset Source: rst_mod_g_rst_n
